x: Chas Walker, although suffering from the after-effects of a cold, ran a good first "leg" which was inside the previous lap record time, held by Bill Lucas, but even so could only hand over in second place to Cook, of Hadleigh A.C.
Our scorers were Penny (3rd), Duffett(4th), Mitchell (5th), Cook (7th), Footer (9th) and Rice (15th). South London Harriers (120) were second and Mitcham A.C.

His present plans include returning for the European circuit this summer and he hopes to be able to help us in our fight for promotion to the British League. February 5th 1982 Inglewood 60y; 1.Cook 6.18; 2.Egbumike (Nig) 6.21; 3.E.Obeng 6.24.

It undoubtedley upset John's rhythm and a lap or so later he was not ideally placed when Elliott and Cook kicked for home. Nevertheless our man finished as quickly as the two ahead of him, if not as fast as Ovett who had rejoined the race, (Elliott 2.21.92 Cook 2.22.13 J Gladwin 2.23.18 Morrell 2.23.43 Ovett 2.23.81)
